units.text: INT. HOLLOW OAK TAVERN - NIGHT
A tavern built inside the trunk of a dead oak the size of a cathedral.
Lanterns hang from root-beams.
The bar is a single slab of petrified heartwood, worn silver by centuries of elbows.
KAELEN MOSSWELL, 20s, a ranger with a bowstring scar across one cheek, nurses a mug at the bar.
MOTHER YSOLDE, 70s, a bent innkeeper with moth-wing earrings, wipes the same cup over and over.
BRANNOCH, 50s, a barrel-chested dwarf in a miner's leather, sits in the corner with an axe across his lap.
PIP, 10, a stable-hand, sweeps near the door.
VEYRA, 30s, hooded, a gray cloak pooled around her chair, sits alone with an untouched bowl.
Quiet tonight.
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: It's always quiet when the root-winds turn.
units.name: MOTHER YSOLDE

units.text: Quiet's what you get when the road's closed.
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: Pip stops sweeping.
Veyra's spoon clinks against the bowl.
Closed since when?
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: Since someone burned the toll-bridge. Three nights back.
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: Don't start, Brannoch.
units.name: MOTHER YSOLDE

units.text: I'm only saying what everyone's thinking.
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: He lifts his eyes toward Veyra.
Kaelen follows his gaze.
The hood does not move.
You came in on the north road. Did you see anything?
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: Smoke.
units.name: VEYRA

units.text: Smoke from where?
units.name: KAELEN

units.text: From the bridge.
units.name: VEYRA

units.text: She's lying. The bridge is south.
units.name: PIP

units.text: Brannoch's chair scrapes.
His hands tighten on the axe.
Speak, hooded one. Who sent you?
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: No one sent me.
units.name: VEYRA

units.text: Then why is your cloak dry?
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: Everyone looks at the floor.
Rain is pooling under the door, but the gray cloak is perfectly dry, and where its hem touches the boards, small pale flowers are blooming.
Gods in the roots.
units.name: MOTHER YSOLDE

units.text: Veyra rises.
The hood falls back to show eyes like green fire.
The bridge was mine. The road is mine. Everything that grows under this oak is mine.
units.name: VEYRA

units.text: Brannoch charges.
The axe bites the table where she stood, and the tavern erupts in roots.
